steps.title: Prepare a controlled destination
steps.instructions: Choose a small test amount and verify the recipient and network.
steps.expectedResult: A destination under the learner's control is selected and reviewed.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instructions: Check asset, amount, recipient, network, and fee before approving.
steps.expectedResult: A small test transaction is submitted without revealing secrets.

steps.title: Confirm and reflect
steps.instructions: Observe the transaction status and record safe evidence or reflection.
steps.expectedResult: A confirmation status or public transaction URL is available.
